caseStudy.problem: Python tooling that turns small YAML UI flows into generated XCUITests and review artifacts.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: The Python core discovers project configuration, validates linear flows and generates test sources. The Mac interface calls the CLI; Xcode project mutation is isolated in a Ruby helper.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Prototype for Apple-platform testing. Running generated UI tests needs macOS and Xcode. Linear flows intentionally do not replace arbitrary handwritten UI automation.
